title: HHHusher header
description: A fixed, see-through header for dark first screens: a chunky black-weight wordmark left, a centred translucent pill of small mono links ending in a yellow buy button, and two glass squares right (currency, language). Links turn yellow on hover; the bar slides up while you scroll down and returns on solid dark when you scroll up. Phones show the wordmark, the buy button and a menu square that opens a full-height list.
notes: always dark (wraps itself in .dark); transparent at the top, so the first section should be dark
the currency box is display only; wire it up in your app
name: hhhusher-header
